pr_title: Modified time fix for PCK files
pr_body:
This is a fix [for this issue](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/35179).

*Bugsquad edit:* Fixes #35179.
pr_comments: I decided to use an unused variable `is_using_datapack`. This implementation disables setup up of last modified time on load/save if Godot has loaded `PCK` files previously. This is a hacky fix, but from what I saw in `Filesystem` implementation, I could not really find a real distinction for the handle origins to disable this only on `PCK` files.

Are there any updates on this? I am having trouble reading logs while debugging my runtime loaded mods due to this issue :( 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51226895/86069607-1be9a300-ba83-11ea-90b6-a32665695fe8.png)
I think this could be merged faster if more people could test it. To do so, you should provide a minimal reproduction project that can be used to make sure the fix works as described.
Good idea, tomorrow I'll provide a small GDScript project that utilizes runtime loading of assets from pck files.

[I made a small project that reproduces this issue](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/4856436/PCKLoad.zip)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51226895/86218000-e62ee200-bb88-11ea-9859-fdc68fe6e144.png)
@IlyaStuurFedorov Is this PR still desired? If so, this needs to be rebased on the latest master branch, and the above feedback needs to be addressed.
The user has deleted their account.

issue_context.title: Error about modified time when loading scenes from ".pck" files
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
e889100

**Issue description:**
When loading a scene originated from a ".pck" file, if said scene uses assets, the engine will complain about not being able to get the modified time of the assets:
```
E 0:00:00.518   _get_modified_time: Failed to get modified time for: res://icon.png.
  <C++ Error>   Method/Function Failed, returning: 0
  <C++ Source>  drivers/unix/file_access_unix.cpp:321 @ _get_modified_time()
  <Stack Trace> main.gd:8 @ _ready()
```

**Minimal reproduction project:**
[modified_time_pck.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/4068933/modified_time_pck.zip)
comments: Is there a workaround for this issue? I'm in 3.2.3 and it seems to be a blocking issue for loading resource packs. Some pck files seem to work while others don't.
@graydwarf Could you upload one (or more) working PCK and one (or more) broken PCK here so we can take a look? You can put each of them in a ZIP archive and upload them here.

The only working pck uses the default icon.png so I'm not sure that it's an
apples to apples comparison. I have yet to create a pck file with other
images that works.

review_comments:
I'm not sure this is the correct fix, as this would mean that if you load any data pack (like in your case an external one), modified time would no longer be updated anymore for files which are not in the data pack, since `ProjectSettings::using_datapack` seems to be all or nothing (it was meant for when the game is run from a `.pck`, but not designed to support running the game from source while using additional PCKs for more content).

The problem seems to be that `FileAccess` doesn't use `FileAccessPack` automatically here when trying to load a resource from the PCK (which would return 0 as modified time). I'm not sure how to solve that.

Looking at `ProjectSettings::_load_resource_pack`, it seems ill-prepared for a scenario where you load PCK files from a non-PCK-based project in general, as it switches all future DirAccess to DirAccessPack (but apparently not for FileAccess).
